notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
This update introduces many bug fixes and feature requests that have been voiced by the community since release (complete list on github), most notably:


- Fullscreen mode
- Better input failure handler
- Bugfixes in Text banner, HIT handler, and rocks
- Rephrasing to clarify late game features
- Redesign of Pandemonium rooms
- Widens the initial viewport of PC players 
- Remove softlock when you want to go down the Hawk mountains
- More
